'''Aine 24 (April 8)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[999 NE]] - [[Egwene]], [[Elayne]], and [[Nynaeve]] arrive in [[Tar Valon]] with [[Verin]], [[Mat]], and [[Hurin]].
*[[999 NE]] [[Siuan Sanche]] tasks Egwene and Nynaeve with hunting down the [[Black Ajah]]. The two girls are attacked by a [[Gray Man]].
*[[999 NE]] - Mat is [[Healed]] and separated from the [[ruby-hilted dagger|dagger]] from [[Shadar Logoth]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Perrin]] prepares for the attack on the [[Shaido]] camp by warning the wolves and dumping [[forkroot]] into their water supply.
